title: What is the ratio of Hydrogen elements in molecule ID TR006? List the ratio
question:
What is the ratio of Hydrogen elements in molecule ID TR006? List the ratio with its label.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: hydrogen refers to element = 'h'; ratio = DIVIDE(SUM(element = 'h'), count(element)) where molecule_id = 'TR006' ; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; label = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic
